Flatten raw universe data.frame by matching R, OS, and arch information from _jobs with _binaries

get_uni_df.Rd

Adds additional columns to _jobs_r_xy, _binaries_r_xy, _jobs_type, _jobs_arch, _jobs_os_, _binaries_os_

Usage

get_uni_df(raw_df)

Arguments

raw_df

raw data.frame from R Universe API

Value

data.frame

Examples

raw_df <- get_raw_uni_df("bioc")
get_uni_df(raw_df)
